d: Donald Trump has fired Sean Cairncross, America's National Cyber Director, amid growing concerns over cybersecurity and AI-powered threats. The move comes as the US grapples with a wave of technology disruptions affecting Microsoft, Apple, airlines, banks and even the National Security Agency. Meanwhile, JPMorgan Chase has revealed a potential data breach involving third-party service providers.
